seo_title: Cost of Living in Nha Trang 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Nha Trang per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A resort with the largest Russian-speaking community in Southeast Asia: menus in Russian, direct flights from Russia, low prices and a warm ocean year-round. Ideal for wintering and long-term remote work.
pros: The largest Russian-speaking community in Southeast Asia
Low prices for housing and food
A long beach and a warm sea year-round
Menus in Russian at most restaurants in the resort area
cons: A very touristy and at times chaotic city
Poor infrastructure quality outside the centre
Air and beaches lose their cleanliness in high season
Difficulties with long-term visas and legal work

best_places.name: Tran Phu Beach
best_places.description: A 7 km city beach with a palm-lined promenade — the main hub of resort life.

best_places.name: Vinpearl
best_places.description: An island with an amusement park, a water park and a cable car over the sea.

best_places.name: Po Nagar Cham Towers
best_places.description: An ancient 9th-century religious site on a cliff by the river.

best_places.name: Hub Coworking Nha Trang
best_places.description: The main spot for remote workers and winterers, with meeting rooms and open space.

visa_steps.title: E-Visa
visa_steps.description: An electronic visa for 90 days for Russian citizens, issued online.

visa_steps.title: DN Business Visa
visa_steps.description: Through an invitation from a Vietnamese company or agent. Up to 1 year with extension.

visa_steps.title: Tax registration
visa_steps.description: An MST (tax code) is required for a bank account and long-term rental.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Vietcombank, BIDV, Sacombank — they open accounts with a DN visa and a rental contract.

visa_steps.title: Renting housing
visa_steps.description: Long-term contracts from 3 months, usually arranged through Russian-speaking agents.

faq.question: Best season in Nha Trang?
faq.answer: January to August — dry and warm. September to November — rain and storms.

faq.question: Is Nha Trang good for children?
faq.answer: There are several international schools and Russian kindergartens. But the choice is smaller than in Da Nang or Bangkok.

faq.question: Which district should I choose in Nha Trang?
faq.answer: Tran Phu — the beach centre. Vinhomes — modern complexes. Hon Chong — quieter, for families.

faq.question: What is healthcare like in Nha Trang?
faq.answer: Vinmec Nha Trang is the main private clinic. Complex cases are taken to Ho Chi Minh City or Singapore.

faq.question: What about bank cards in Nha Trang?
faq.answer: Russian cards don't work. Local banks open accounts with a DN visa.

faq.question: Should I learn Vietnamese in Nha Trang?
faq.answer: You can get by with English and Russian in the resort area, but beyond it basic Vietnamese helps.

reviews.text: I've been wintering in Nha Trang for the fifth year: housing in Vinhomes, a business with Russians. It's resort-like and a bit noisy in summer, but in the off-season it's calm and warm.
We rent an apartment by the sea for 25,000 rubles, the kids go to an international school. The downside — Nha Trang is still a resort, and sometimes you miss the quiet.
